user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry reading and explicitly simulated normal/boundary walkthroughs; existing body knowledge disclosed. Not independent agent runs or human research. Actual offline executions individually marked.

scenarios.request: 18 g in, 36 g out, 20 seconds including preinfusion, 93 C, sour but even flow; usual recipe 28 seconds.
scenarios.expected: One controlled next step, no invented grinder dial.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough recommends slightly finer with dose/yield/temp fixed and requests new time/taste. Before table combined three changes; after one-input change only.

scenarios.request: Same recipe, sour and drying, spraying; photo color disagrees with bag label.
scenarios.expected: Consider uneven extraction and visual uncertainty.
scenarios.observed: Before fast timing overrode taste and photo overrode label. After walkthrough prioritizes distribution as one change, flags photo uncertainty, records label as supplied evidence, does not infer processing from image.

scenarios.request: Hotel grinder unknown; home memory unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Generic grind guidance and copyable profile; no home dial or persistence claim.
scenarios.observed: Existing fallback remains usable in walkthrough; no physical coffee was brewed or tasted.

similar_skills.learned: Taste feedback and mixed sour/bitter channeling deserve a separate branch; machine-specific recipes include fast intentional shots.
similar_skills.reason: Add contextual timing, evenness and one-variable recovery. Reject fixed GaggiMate host, automatic machine deployment and mandatory community-profile edits; no code copied.

decision: Fix conflicting multi-variable diagnosis, context-free timing certainty and photo certainty. Preserve home setup memory and canonical stable identity. Comparable coffee-skill name was unrelated security tooling and excluded.
